description:
The develop-PR gate (`.github/workflows/pr.yml`, single required check
`ci-required-result` at pr.yml:757-819) never builds the wheel, never
installs it in isolation, and never runs `pip-audit`. Both checks exist
today but only run nightly (`nightly.yml` `test-package` job ~:261-308,
`pip-audit` step ~:111-118) or on `main` (`test.yml`, triggers only on
`push`/`pull_request` to `main`, test.yml:3-9). The nightly `test-package`
job's own comment (nightly.yml:300-303) states this exact minimal-import
contract's absence "let v0.3.0 ship a broken clean install" - i.e. this
gap has already caused a real regression that reached a release before
any CI lane caught it. A `pyproject.toml`/`MANIFEST.in`/`uv.lock` change
can land on develop today with zero build/install/audit signal until the
next nightly run or the `main` release PR.

This item path-filters both checks into the develop-PR required lane
using the existing classifier so unrelated PRs (e.g. a docs-only or
single-test-file change) pay no extra CI cost.

anti_patterns.dont: let a skipped package-smoke/dependency-audit job silently pass ci-required-result on a PR that DID touch packaging files
anti_patterns.instead: verify the path-filter output, not just the job result, gates the check.
anti_patterns.why: that reintroduces the exact gap this TODO closes

anti_patterns.dont: make package-smoke or dependency-audit run unconditionally on every PR
anti_patterns.why: most PRs never touch packaging metadata and the whole point is targeted, cheap promotion

anti_patterns.dont: refactor nightly.yml's test-package job into a shared reusable workflow as part of this change
anti_patterns.instead: copy the step bodies into pr.yml and let them diverge if needed.

preserves.behavior: Non-packaging PRs see no new required job execution time (path filter must correctly skip both jobs).
ci-required-result's existing skipped-counts-as-pass semantics for audit-sha (pr.yml:789-793) as the pattern to extend, not replace.
nightly.yml's test-package OS matrix (ubuntu + windows) and its own pip-audit step remain unchanged and continue running nightly independently of this PR-time addition.

prior_art.concept: nightly.yml:111-118 pip-audit step — reuse the ignore-vuln parsing
nightly.yml:261-308 test-package job — reuse the build/install/minimal-import steps verbatim
pr.yml:757-819 ci-required-result conditional-job pattern (audit-sha skipped-counts-as-pass) — extend with the same shape for the two new jobs

verifications.command: git checkout -b scratch/break-manifest && echo 'exclude benchbox/py.typed' >> MANIFEST.in && git commit -am 'scratch: break manifest' && gh pr create --fill --base develop && gh pr checks --watch
verifications.description: Breaking MANIFEST.in on a scratch branch turns package-smoke red
A docs-only PR skips both new jobs and still passes
verifications.expected: package-smoke and dependency-audit show skipped; ci-required-result succeeds

verifications.description: pip-audit job fails on an intentionally vulnerable pinned dep in a scratch branch
verifications.expected: matches nightly's existing pip-audit behavior when a known vuln is present

work_units.notes:
Done. Extended the classifier generically instead of a single-purpose
"packaging" special case: `scripts/path_filter_decision.py` now derives
any non-core key in `.github/path-filters.yml` as an "extra group"
(`extra_group_keys()`), emitting `<group>_paths`/`<group>_needed`
decision keys, a `<group>-needed` GH Actions output, and a
`<group>.txt` helper list automatically. Added a `packaging:` group to
path-filters.yml (pyproject.toml, MANIFEST.in, setup.py, setup.cfg,
benchbox/__init__.py, uv.lock) and a `viz:` group reused by
parity-check-develop-ring.yaml (see that TODO). Added `package-smoke`
job to pr.yml, gated on `needs.ci-paths.outputs.packaging-needed`,
copying nightly.yml's test-package steps verbatim (ubuntu/3.12 only,
no matrix, no artifact upload - PR gate doesn't need the dist
artifact). Original notes:
Add a `package-smoke` job to pr.yml gated on a new path-filter output
(extend `scripts/path_filter_decision.py` / `.github/path-filters.yml`
with a `packaging` group covering `pyproject.toml`, `MANIFEST.in`,
`setup.py`/`setup.cfg`, `benchbox/__init__.py`, `uv.lock`). Reuse the
nightly `test-package` job's steps verbatim where possible: `uv build`,
assert exactly one wheel (nightly.yml:291-296), then the isolated
install + minimal-import assertion (nightly.yml:300-304): import
`benchbox` succeeds AND `importlib.util.find_spec('pandas') is None`,
plus `benchbox --help`. Single ubuntu-latest/3.12 leg is sufficient for
the PR gate; leave the full OS matrix (ubuntu + windows) to nightly.
work_units.summary: Path-filtered package build + isolated install + minimal-import smoke job in pr.yml
